alternative_explanations: Any iterative gain may come only from ordinary autoregressive self-conditioning or confidence scheduling rather than simultaneous representation refinement; one-pass, left-to-right and parallel fixed controls separate these accounts.
confounds: Candidate-declared internal critical path is an audited algorithmic estimate rather than a hardware proof; any hidden per-position sequential loop, target access, path access or within-round state mutation invalidates the cohort.
falsification_criteria: Make HYP-0017 dormant without tuning if iterative fails to improve mean bits per byte by at least 0.05 over forced one-pass in both D=4 and D=6 cells, or if its aggregate mean or worst-span loss is not at least 0.05 below every implementable control.

Kill the tested mechanism if exact-span accuracy is not at least 0.02 above one-pass, if L=128 D=6 declared critical path exceeds 60, or if any implementable classical control Pareto-dominates quality, critical path, R16 work and state.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any frozen corpus mismatch or overlap with the EXP-0044 corpus.
Invalidate if a public query exposes a path, target byte, uncorrupted span or future refinement snapshot.
Invalidate if predictions within one round observe another prediction from that same round.
Invalidate if candidate critical-path work is sequentially hidden inside a declared simultaneous step.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, seed leakage, byte-permutation leakage or evaluator-integrity change.

outcome_policy.negative: A crash rejects only implementation; leakage, hidden sequential work, seed collision, missing control, state breach or evaluator change invalidates the cohort and forbids interpretation.
outcome_policy.null: A valid null or classical dominance result makes HYP-0017 dormant without changing corpus, mask geometry, reveal schedule, context, model order or state cap.
outcome_policy.positive: A valid one-seed success justifies a new-corpus three-seed adversarial screen and no promotion.

predicted_outcome: The iterative learner may improve over its one-pass ablation by using self-filled context, but exact bidirectional Markov or parallel fixed belief propagation will probably match or beat its conditional loss at lower full work; a valid large advantage would authorize only replication.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote; authorize only a three-seed disjoint-corpus screen if all loss, ablation, critical-depth and Pareto gates pass with intact evaluator and source audit.
research_question: Can one simultaneous masked byte learner use bounded iterative feedback to reconstruct unseen 8/32/128-byte spans with better conditional quality per full work and critical-path depth than its forced one-pass ablation and exact classical bidirectional controls?
title: Parallel masked refinement on unseen whole-file spans
